prompt:
Our strategic research team needs a daily intelligence briefing. We track both the technology industry and the defense/military sector. I need you to gather today's news from our standard monitoring sources, apply our standard editorial quality filters, and produce a structured briefing document called `daily_briefing.md` in the workspace.

A local news data service is already running at http://localhost:8765 (it has endpoints like /all, /all/tech, /all/military, and per-source endpoints). You can use this as a data source.

The briefing must cover both technology and military topics, properly organized by category. Make sure the content quality is high — we've had problems in the past with low-quality rumors, forum speculation, and unverified anonymous tips ending up in the briefing. The final document should be clean, professional, and follow our standard newsroom format.
